description: For a supplied nonprincipal ultrafilter U on the naturals and any countable family B of subsets, B is not a base for U.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.no_countable_ultrafilter_base (U : Ultrafilter ℕ)
  (hU : ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiltersAndUltrafilters.IsPrincipal ↑U) (B : Set (Set ℕ)) (hB : B.Countable) :
  ¬(↑U).HasBasis (fun A => A ∈ B) id
